weak_lookup.description: Returns a pointer to a value that is only weakly referenced (e.g., from a weak table); the returned pointer does not keep the object alive.

gc_trigger.description: Function call that may allocate memory and trigger a garbage collection; any weakly referenced object passed to it must be anchored beforehand.

ref_get.description: Anchors/roots a GC object so it will not be collected; after this call the object is strongly referenced.
